#### `dateFormat`

Specify date format for UI display

#### `datePickerId`

Internal ID only for labeling date picker popup

#### `days`

Container for current days in month

#### `disabled`

Disabled attribute

#### `disabledMaxDate`

Maximum date for disabled dates (format: yyyy/mm/dd)

#### `disabledMinDate`

Minimum date for disabled dates (format: yyyy/mm/dd)

#### `fullDateFormat`

Specify "full" date format for aria role

#### `iconName`

Field note icon name

#### `isDayShortHand`

Show the day of the week as a short hand, e.g. "M" for Monday

#### `monthSelectorLabel`

Accessible name for the month/year picker popup.

The popup is `role="dialog"` and its content is a grid of year headings and
month buttons, so it had no accessible name at all — a screen reader
announced "dialog" and nothing else. Settable rather than hardcoded so it
can be localised, matching `timeSelectorLabel` / `cancelLabel` on
al-date-time-picker.

#### `multiYear`

Amount of years to go before and after the current date

#### `resetDates`

Make active calendar date inactive

#### `selectedDate`

Selected date

#### `setActiveDate`

Set a specific date to be active

#### `showMonthPopup`

Value to track month picker display

#### `startOnMonday`

Start the day of the week on Monday

#### `years`

Container for years toggle
